name: J35 Pro
summary: Compact multi-material PolyJet for the design office.

page.description: Stratasys J35 Pro 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: The versatile
page.lead: Up to three materials on one tray (rigid, rubber-like, clear and biocompatible) in a compact, quiet printer that costs less than other PolyJet systems†.
page.footnote: † Stratasys claim. Source: stratasys.com J35 Pro page, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: High-fidelity prototypes
features.text: Detail close to the final product.

features.title: Office-friendly
features.text: Low maintenance, small footprint, quiet, with air filtration.

benefits.title: Realistic CMF prototypes
benefits.text: Greyscale, transparency, texture and moving parts.

benefits.title: Lower investment
benefits.text: Less than other PolyJet systems (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Versatile materials
benefits.text: Rubber-like, high-impact, rigid, translucent and biocompatible.

specs.label: Build size
specs.value: Round print tray up to 1,174 cm²; maximum model height 155 mm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: Under 100 mm: ±150 µm. Over 100 mm: ±0.15 % of part length (rigid materials, 1σ)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: ToughONE, VeroUltra, VeroUltra Clear, DraftGrey, Elastico, Digital ABS Plus

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, FCC, EAC, cTUVus, CB, RCM

page.applications_heading: Design and functional prototypes, in the office.
